items.factual_review: The annotated 1615 title page names Miguel de Cervantes as author of both parts, identifies Madrid, Juan de Cuesta and Francisco de Robles, and notes that Cuesta's name remained the workshop name after his departure. The Instituto Cervantes conference description distinguishes the 1605 and 1615 books. The article correctly distinguishes work parts from the physical volumes of later editions.
